fixture: Passive clock ticks are paused. The fair arrival supplies 198 coins and the harness sets starting trust to 45. q01 uses Saturday at 10:00. q02–q06 use the same evening at 20:00. The remaining runs are made on later nights using the live offer. q07–q09 show the accumulated wallet and the existing daylight lane towards the square the following morning. Position and camera fixtures frame that lane and return the player to the Quay for the next run.
method: Real native Godot viewport. Viewport-local clicks exercise arrival, the route to the Quay, both offer choices, return to the Quay map and What people say.
